method: Same-baseline DEM comparison. Earth uses a 12.8 km centre crop of the generated 40 m Copernicus GLO-30 heightmap, resampled to 400 m and 463 m. Moon and Mars reference statistics are reused from the curated planetaryReference.json.

moon.name: Lunar south pole / Shackleton region
moon.source: LRO LOLA 400 m south-polar stereographic DEM (LDEM_45S_400M, PDS LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0)
moon.note: Slope and roughness are derived from a DEM at the stated baseline. Absolute elevation uses a body-specific datum and is not a cross-body similarity metric.

mars.name: Jezero crater floor / landing region
mars.source: MGS MOLA 463 m global DEM COG (mola128_mola64_merge_90Nto90S)
mars.note: Slope and roughness are derived from a DEM at the stated baseline. Absolute elevation uses a body-specific datum and is not a cross-body similarity metric.
